correctness.rationale: The three-by-three unit-modulus rigidity argument reduces all singular minors to proportional row/column pairs. The indicator identity accounts separately for their intersections and rank-one overcount. Character annihilators yield the totient divisor sum P; simultaneous pair extensions yield Q; and Möbius inversion yields L. These components prove the all-N rank partition and the exact order-30 instance, which is checked by independent integer-cyclotomic and finite-prime computations.

evidence: Delvaux–Van Barel TW470/TW477 construct maximal rank-deficient blocks, FFT blocks and subgroup tilings, rather than full rank incidence of every selected 3×3 minor.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General uncertainty lower bounds and maximal defect blocks do not imply a complete count of all rank-one/rank-two/full-rank restrictions. The all-order claim dominates known prime-power and semiprime examples in domain but does not attempt to supersede their additional spectral/support statements.

originality.rationale: The bounded primary/full-text and published-comparison searches found no all-order cyclic third-minor rank-incidence divisor-sum theorem. The rank-defect mechanism is known, but earlier results give special-group classifications, maximal-defect constructions, or minimum-support uncertainty. None of the inspected statements implies exact rank multiplicities for arbitrary cyclic N. An unindexed equivalent result remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: The unit-modulus 3-by-3 rank-defect criterion is preexisting; an unindexed all-order multiplicity formula may already be implicit in older incidence-algebra or Fourier-design literature.
The bounded public source comparison does not establish historical uniqueness or independently validate the proof.

value.rationale: The complete distribution of Fourier sample-map ranks is a natural identifiability invariant. An all-cyclic arithmetic law resolves higher-mixed-prime orders not covered by known prime-power or semiprime classifications. Rank-one and rank-two losses both occur at N=30, making their exact separate multiplicities structurally meaningful beyond one isolated table.
